name: Integer operations
tip: Multiply before you add or subtract, and treat subtracting a negative as adding.

name: Subtracting negatives in a fraction
tip: a − (−b) = a + b. Simplify the numerator first, then reduce.

name: Changes with negative numbers
tip: Apply each change in order: a rise adds, a drop subtracts.

name: Absolute value expressions
tip: Evaluate inside the bars first. An absolute value is never negative.

name: Order of operations with fractions
tip: Multiply before adding, even when the numbers are fractions.

name: Unit price
tip: Unit price = total price ÷ number of items.

name: One-step metric conversion
tip: Going from a bigger unit to a smaller unit, multiply.

name: Scaling a recipe
tip: Multiply the original amount by (new quantity ÷ old quantity).

name: Rates with minutes and hours
tip: Convert minutes to hours (÷ 60) before using a per-hour rate.

name: Multistep unit conversion
tip: Write the units at each step so they cancel: gallons per minute × minutes × liters per gallon.

name: Percent decrease
tip: Percent change = change ÷ original amount, not the new amount.

name: Squares and roots in an expression
tip: Evaluate the power and the root first, then subtract.

name: Exponent rules
tip: Same base multiplied: add exponents. Power of a power: multiply exponents.

name: Scientific notation
tip: Multiply the numbers, add the exponents, then adjust so the number is between 1 and 10.

name: Negative exponents
tip: a<sup>−n</sup> = 1 / a<sup>n</sup>. A negative exponent makes a reciprocal, not a negative number.

name: Fractional exponents
tip: For a<sup>p/q</sup>, take the q-th root first, then raise to the power p.

name: Simplifying square roots
tip: Pull out the largest perfect-square factor.

name: Evaluating with a negative value
tip: Put a negative value in parentheses when you substitute. A negative number squared is positive.

name: Translating words to expressions
tip: “Less than” reverses the order. “The sum of” needs parentheses when it is multiplied.

name: Equivalent expressions
tip: Distribute first, then combine like terms.

name: Writing a cost expression
tip: One-time amounts are added once. Per-unit amounts multiply their variable.

name: Input of a nonlinear function
tip: Set the function equal to the given output and solve for the input.

name: Two-step equations
tip: Undo the addition or subtraction first, then the multiplication.

name: Equations with parentheses
tip: Distribute, then move the x-terms to one side and the numbers to the other.

name: Equations with fractions
tip: Multiply every term by a common denominator to clear the fractions.

name: Linear inequalities
tip: Multiplying or dividing by a negative number flips the inequality sign.

name: Systems by elimination
tip: Add or subtract the equations so one variable cancels.

name: Reading coordinates
tip: (x, y): the horizontal position comes first, then the vertical.

name: Substituting into a linear equation
tip: Replace the known variable with its value, then solve for the other.

name: Modeling with a linear equation
tip: Total = rate × variable + one-time fee.

name: Slope from two points
tip: Slope = (y₂ − y₁) ÷ (x₂ − x₁). Keep the same point order on top and bottom.

name: Line from an intercept and a point
tip: Find the slope from the two points; the y-intercept is b.

name: Line from a table
tip: Slope = change in y ÷ change in x. Check your equation against every row.

name: Interpreting slope and intercept
tip: The constant is the starting value; the coefficient of the variable is the rate of change.

name: Parallel lines
tip: Parallel lines have the same slope. Use the given point to find b.

name: Perpendicular lines
tip: A perpendicular slope is the negative reciprocal: flip the fraction and change the sign.

name: Line from a graph
tip: Read b where the line crosses the y-axis, then count rise over run.

name: System word problems
tip: Write one equation for the number of things and one for the total value.

name: Simple probability
tip: Favorable outcomes ÷ total outcomes.

name: Compound probability
tip: Count outcomes in the full sample space, or multiply independent probabilities.

name: Conditional probability from a table
tip: The condition sets the denominator: use that row or column total, not the grand total.

name: Union and intersection
tip: ∩ means in both sets; ∪ means in either set, listed once.

name: Combined set operations
tip: Do the operation in parentheses first.

name: Probability without replacement
tip: After each draw, reduce both the favorable count and the total by one.

name: Reading a bar graph
tip: Read each bar against the gridlines, then compare.

name: Finding the mean
tip: Add all the values, then divide by how many there are.

name: Median of an even-sized set
tip: Sort the values first, then average the two middle ones.

name: Effect of an outlier
tip: An extreme value pulls the mean much more than the median.

name: Missing value from a mean
tip: Total = mean × count. Subtract the known values from the total.

name: Comparing two data sets
tip: Find each mean and median separately; they can point in different directions.

name: Change between paired bars
tip: Compute each change. The tallest bar is not always the biggest increase.

name: Reading a box plot
tip: Range = maximum − minimum. IQR = Q3 − Q1, the width of the box.

name: Rectangle perimeter
tip: Perimeter = 2 × (length + width).

name: Triangle area
tip: Area = ½ × base × height.

name: Circle area and circumference
tip: Area = πr² and circumference = 2πr. Halve a diameter to get the radius.

name: Missing dimension of a prism
tip: Height = volume ÷ (length × width).

name: Pythagorean theorem
tip: a² + b² = c², where c is the hypotenuse, the longest side.

name: Distance between points
tip: Distance = √(Δx² + Δy²), the Pythagorean theorem on the grid.

name: Single transformations
tip: x-axis: (x, −y). y-axis: (−x, y). 90° counterclockwise: (−y, x). 90° clockwise: (y, −x). 180°: (−x, −y).

name: Perimeter and area expressions
tip: Write the length in terms of w first, then put it into the formula.

name: Two transformations in a row
tip: Apply the transformations in the stated order, one at a time.

name: Powers and square roots
tip: a<sup>n</sup> means multiply a by itself n times. A square root undoes squaring.

name: Simplifying a ratio
tip: Divide both parts by their greatest common factor, and keep the order the question asks for.

name: Converting km/h to m/s
tip: Multiply by 1,000 (km to m) and divide by 3,600 (hours to seconds).

name: Spinner probability
tip: Favorable sections ÷ total equal sections.

name: Translating a point
tip: Right or left changes x; up or down changes y.

name: Scaling volume
tip: Multiplying every length by k multiplies the volume by k³.

name: Area with a cutout
tip: Area of the whole shape minus the area of the cutout.

name: Solving for y in terms of x
tip: Move the x-term, then divide every term by the coefficient of y.

name: Reading a scatter plot
tip: Points rising left to right show a positive association; falling shows a negative one.

name: Line of best fit
tip: Estimate the y-intercept where the cloud of points starts, then the rise over run across the cloud.

name: Predicting from a line of best fit
tip: Substitute the given x-value into the line’s equation.

name: Reading a histogram
tip: Each bar counts the values in its interval. Add the bars that match the condition.

name: Mode
tip: The mode is the value that appears most often.

name: Inequalities on a number line
tip: Open circle: not included (< or >). Filled circle: included (≤ or ≥). The arrow shows the direction.

name: Linear vs. nonlinear functions
tip: Linear means x only to the first power: no squares, no x in an exponent or a denominator.

name: Solutions of a two-variable inequality
tip: Substitute the point and check whether the inequality is true.

name: Comparing linear functions
tip: Find each function’s slope and y-intercept, from a table, graph, or equation, then compare.

name: Compound inequalities
tip: Do the same operation to all three parts at once.

name: Inequalities with variables on both sides
tip: Collect x-terms on one side. Flip the sign if you divide by a negative.

name: Checking a solution to a system
tip: A solution must make every equation in the system true.

name: Probability of A or B
tip: P(A or B) counts each outcome once: subtract the overlap if you add.

name: Experimental probability and predictions
tip: Use the observed fraction, then multiply by the number of new trials.

name: Independent vs. dependent events
tip: Dependent: the first outcome changes the chances for the second (usually “without replacement”).

name: Set-builder notation
tip: Read the rule and the boundaries: < excludes the endpoint, ≤ includes it.

name: Operations with decimals
tip: Multiply before adding, and track the sign.

name: Complex fractions
tip: A fraction over a fraction is division: multiply by the reciprocal of the bottom.

name: Absolute value inequalities
tip: |x − a| < k means x is within k units of a.

name: Scale drawings
tip: Multiply the drawing length by the number of real units per drawing unit.

name: Estimating a population with a proportion
tip: Tagged in sample ÷ sample size = tagged total ÷ population.

name: Cube roots
tip: The cube root of n is the number that, used three times as a factor, gives n.

name: Estimating square roots
tip: Find the perfect squares just below and just above the number.

name: Converting to scientific notation
tip: One nonzero digit before the decimal point; the exponent counts how far the point moved.

name: Rational exponents and radicals
tip: x<sup>p/q</sup> is the q-th root of x<sup>p</sup>: the denominator is the root.

name: Evaluating with several variables
tip: Substitute every value in parentheses, then follow the order of operations.

name: Absolute value expressions
tip: Evaluate inside the bars first, then take the absolute value.

name: Rectangles on the coordinate plane
tip: Side lengths are differences of coordinates.

name: Volume of a composite solid
tip: Whole volume minus the part that is removed.

name: Dilations
tip: Centered at the origin, multiply both coordinates by the scale factor.

name: Area with polynomials
tip: Multiply every term of one factor by every term of the other, then combine like terms.

name: Pythagorean word problems
tip: Find the right triangle and its hypotenuse, then use a² + b² = c².
